verdict.rationale: A state corporation registry could plausibly publish a public data API, so this axis applies. The pack contains only robots.txt probes for www.scc.virginia.gov and cis.scc.virginia.gov, both disallowing all crawling, so none of the Commission's pages were fetched. There is no evidence of published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits. Confidence is low because the sites themselves went unexamined.
